name: Campaign Monitor
label: Campaign Monitor REST API v3.3 — subscribers, lists, campaigns
description: Official Campaign Monitor REST API v3.3 at https://api.createsend.com/api/v3.3. Handler: OfficialApiNode. HTTP Basic api_key:x (username=API key, password=x). JSON paths only. Customer owns the account. Minimize subscriber fields. api_key is never logged or returned. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger.listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"subscriber.add"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: subscriber.add | subscriber.get | subscriber.update | subscriber.unsubscribe | subscriber.delete | list.create | list.get | campaign.create | campaign.send | campaign.unsent | transactional.send | trigger.listen. trigger.listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: listId
schema.description: Subscriber list id (path). Required for subscriber.* and list.get.

schema.label: clientId
schema.description: Client/tenant id for list.create, campaign.create, campaign.unsent.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Query email= for get/update/delete. URL-encoded by the engine.

schema.label: EmailAddress
schema.description: Subscriber email in JSON bodies. Minimize: this address only.

schema.label: Name
schema.description: Display name: subscriber name on subscriber.add/update, campaign name on campaign.create (required there, unique per client). Example: November Newsletter.

schema.label: ConsentToTrack
schema.description: Yes | No | Unchanged. Customer's consent duty; recommended on add/update/send.

schema.label: Resubscribe
schema.description: Re-add a previously unsubscribed person. Do not default true.

schema.label: campaignId
schema.description: Draft campaign id for campaign.send.

schema.label: smartEmailId
schema.description: Smart transactional email id. Classic send is POST /transactional/classicEmail/send (not this verb).

schema.label: To
schema.description: Transactional recipients (strings). Consented addresses only.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Smart-email merge variables. Minimize PII.

schema.label: ConfirmationEmail
schema.description: campaign.send confirmation recipient.

schema.label: SendDate
schema.description: Immediately or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.

schema.label: Title
schema.description: list.create name.

schema.label: UnsubscribeSetting
schema.description: AllClientLists (recommended) or OnlyThisList.

schema.label: MobileNumber
schema.description: Request-body parameter `MobileNumber` for operations: subscriber.add, subscriber.update.

schema.label: CustomFields
schema.description: Request-body parameter `CustomFields` for operations: subscriber.add, subscriber.update.

schema.label: ConsentToSendSms
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ConsentToSendSms` for operations: subscriber.add, subscriber.update.

schema.label: RestartSubscriptionBasedAutoresponders
schema.description: Request-body parameter `RestartSubscriptionBasedAutoresponders` for operation: subscriber.add.

schema.label: ConfirmedOptIn
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ConfirmedOptIn` for operation: list.create.

schema.label: Subject
schema.description: Campaign subject line; required by campaign.create. Example: Our November update.

schema.label: FromName
schema.description: Sender display name; required by campaign.create. Example: Acme Marketing.

schema.label: FromEmail
schema.description: Sender email address (must be a verified sender domain); required by campaign.create. Example: news@example.com.

schema.label: ReplyTo
schema.description: Reply-to email address; required by campaign.create. Example: reply@example.com.

schema.label: HtmlUrl
schema.description: Public URL Campaign Monitor imports the campaign HTML from; required by campaign.create. Example: https://example.com/newsletter.html.

schema.label: ListIDs
schema.description: List IDs the campaign is sent to on campaign.create. campaign.create needs ListIDs or SegmentIDs (at least one). Example: ["a58ee1d3039b8bec838e6d1482a8a965"].

schema.label: SegmentIDs
schema.description: Segment IDs the campaign is sent to on campaign.create; alternative to (or combined with) ListIDs. Example: ["9b1d4b1a1e8a4b3c8f0a2c7d5e6f7a8b"].

schema.label: AddRecipientsToList
schema.description: Request-body parameter `AddRecipientsToList` for operation: transactional.send.

schema.label: CC
schema.description: Request-body parameter `CC` for operation: transactional.send.

schema.label: BCC
schema.description: Request-body parameter `BCC` for operation: transactional.send.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Log ids only — bodies may contain PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: subscriber.add, subscriber.get, subscriber.update, subscriber.unsubscribe, subscriber.delete, list.create, list.get, campaign.create, campaign.send, campaign.unsent, transactional.send, trigger.listen. Selecting trigger.listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Campaign Monitor API key, sent as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password (Campaign Monitor ignores the password). Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Clientid
configurationParameters.description: Campaign Monitor client (tenant) id. Path {clientId} for list.create, campaign.create, campaign.unsent. Also accepted on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Listid
configurationParameters.description: Default list id for subscriber ops when INPUT listId is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
